contract: 18 native presentations produce five output segments at one/four decoder threads; source-epoch-only change continues first segment.
Dimension, CICP, depth/subsampling and clock changes select prepared real encoders; FFmpeg/libdav1d verifies exact native components in all segments.
Fixed output publishes a real IVF header outside the operation before the changed frame is refused. Partial header error/unwind leaves external bytes intact and terminates the operation.
Cancellation and timeout preserve reasons before preparation, during initial/replacement policy and at finish. Callback causes, stale tokens, decline and storage failures remain terminal.
Unknown workspace cannot satisfy a required bound. Required metadata/opaque-profile rules refuse offers without corresponding evidence.
Native encoders drop before compressed segments are returned. Retained packet clones keep payload charges until their final owner drops.
limits: Private finite native adapter, not a packaged video transcode API.
No in-band container reconfiguration, prepared planar conversion, live sequential-output qualification or general spool.
The external header writer is a buffer, not an HTTP server or complete container transaction. Header writes themselves may block while an encoder is live.
Encoded payload admission excludes native codec/reference/workspace, caller input owners, codec configuration, list bookkeeping and native output allocation before admission.
Independent component readback does not prove color-signaling correctness.
Resource lines describe build/test processes, not whole-operation bounds or comparative performance.
